--exit-code.help: exit code to return when this script exits

--port.help: port to run the test app on

--sleep-after-stop-signal.help: time to sleep after getting the signal before exiting

--stop-after.help: stop the process after duration (overrides all other flags if set)

--use-sigusr1.help: use SIGUSR1 as the stop signal, instead of the default SIGTERM
